examples.en: Today is a special day.
He served in a special unit.
A prisoner escaped last night.
The guards counted the prisoners.
What size are you?
Do you have this in a smaller size?

meanings: to see through, to figure out (colloq.)

examples.en: Someone broke into our apartment.
I've got you figured out, don't lie!

tips: In slang «провалити» means to figure out, to get it: «давно сам провалила да му се свиђаш». The basic meaning is to collapse, to cave in.
Colloquially, besides «to break in», it means to get to the bottom of something: «нисам провалио шта хоће» - I didn't get what he wants.

examples.en: What do you suggest?
I suggest we leave right away.

meanings: to get off, to get out (of a vehicle)

examples.en: Come down, a taxi is waiting for you.
We got off the bus downtown.
This area is dangerous at night.
That's not my field of work.
I love modern art.
Cooking is a real art.

note: not to be confused with «искуство» - experience

examples.en: I'll take you to the airport.
I'll wait for you at the airport.

tips: Serbs say «на аеродрому», not «у аеродрому»: at the airport.

examples.en: I have a feeling someone is watching us.
I like to watch the stars.
You deserve a rest.
She didn't deserve such treatment.

examples.sr: Мој први [у̀читељ] је био веома строг.
examples.en: My first teacher was very strict.

examples.sr: Он ради као [у̀читељ] у основној школи.
examples.en: He works as a teacher in a primary school.

note: in the upper grades the usual word is «наставник»

examples.en: I demand an explanation!
This job requires patience.
I agree, but on one condition.
What are the working conditions like?

examples.sr: Требало му је много [хра̏брости] да јој то каже.
examples.en: It took him a lot of courage to tell her that.
Pluck up your courage and call her.

examples.sr: Деца воле да гледају [ма̀јмуне] у зоолошком врту.
examples.en: Children love to watch the monkeys at the zoo.
You climb trees like a monkey.

tips: Figuratively: a stupid person, an idiot, not just a monkey.
Said to a man, it is a serious insult; the word is masculine («велики мајмун»), vocative «мајмуне!». «магарче!» and «коњу један!» are just as insulting. For an animal at the zoo it is neutral.

examples.sr: Много [му̏ке] сам имао са тим папирима.
examples.en: I had a lot of trouble with those papers.
Bus rides make me sick.

tips: «Мука ми је» - I feel sick. The word on its own also means «suffering»: «са муком» - with difficulty.
«Мука ми је од …» - I'm fed up with ...

examples.en: Do you have a cigarette?
He smoked a cigarette on the terrace.
Last night I fell asleep in front of the TV.
I can't fall asleep because of the noise.
He was fired from his job yesterday.
If you're late again, I'll fire you.

note: «добити отказ» - to get fired; «дати отказ» - to quit, or (of a boss) to fire someone

examples.en: The police have a search warrant.

examples.sr: Направи [на́лог] на сајту и пријави се.
examples.en: Create an account on the site and log in.

tips: «Налог за плаћање» - payment order, «налог за хапшење» - arrest warrant. «Кориснички налог» - user account.
Also an account: направити налог - to create an account, пословни налог - business account. In the legal sense - an order, a warrant.

examples.en: It's another ten kilometers to the city.

examples.sr: Возио је сто осамдесет [киломѐтара] на сат.
examples.en: He drove a hundred and eighty kilometers an hour.
I have fond memories of my childhood.

examples.sr: Тај дан ми је остао у [сѐћању].
examples.en: That day stayed in my memory.
I found the recipe on the internet.

examples.sr: Код куће немамо [и̏нтернет] већ два дана.
examples.en: We haven't had internet at home for two days.

examples.sr: [Сачу̀вај] документ пре него што затвориш програм.
examples.en: Save the document before you close the program.
We managed to save the old house.
My husband is very jealous.
Are you jealous of her?
Allow me to introduce my wife.
He introduced himself as a doctor.
He put on a new suit for the wedding.
This suit looks good on you.

note: «одело» is a suit; clothing in general is «одећа»

examples.sr: Потписао ми је [че̏к] на хиљаду евра.
examples.en: He wrote me a check for a thousand euros.
Can you pay by check?

note: colloq. «чек!» - hold on (from «чекај»); a till receipt is «рачун»

examples.en: My left shoulder hurts.
He put his hand on my shoulder.

tips: «Раме» is the shoulder as the top of the body between the neck and the arm. The upper arm is «надлактица», the forearm «подлактица».
The plural is «рамена»: «Има широка рамена» - he has broad shoulders.

examples.sr: [Увѐрио] сам га да је све у реду.
examples.en: I assured him that everything was fine.
See for yourself!
The newspapers published his interview.
The government announced new measures.
We haven't seen each other for a long time.
I've known him for a long time, since school.
She has a gift for music.
They brought gifts for the newlyweds.

note: in everyday speech a present is more often «поклон»

examples.en: I have no intention of giving up.
He had good intentions.
What is this strange creature?
Poor thing, it's completely soaked.

examples.sr: Мој брат студира на [ко̀леџу] у Америци.
examples.en: My brother studies at a college in America.
We met back in college.

note: usually an American-style college; a Serbian university faculty is «факултет»

examples.en: You've finally arrived!
The rain has finally stopped.
Are you still awake?
I was awake all night.
They found his DNA on the knife.

examples.sr: [ДНК] тест је показао да је он отац.
examples.en: The DNA test showed that he is the father.
Now it's your move.
That was a very smart move.
I fell and scraped my knee.

examples.sr: Клекнуо је на [ко̀лена] и запросио је.
examples.en: He got down on his knees and proposed to her.
We got married last summer.

examples.sr: Свештеник их је [вѐнчао] у старој цркви.
examples.en: The priest married them in the old church.

tips: «Венчати се» - to get married: «Венчали су се у јуну». Used for both a church and a civil wedding.

examples.en: The company hired ten new workers.
I finally got a job!

tips: «Запослити се» - to get a job: «Запослила сам се у продавници». «Запослити некога» - to hire someone.

examples.en: I read your file.
The police already have a file on him.
The bank robbery lasted five minutes.
These prices are a real rip-off!
My grandfather was a brave soldier.

examples.sr: Буди [хра̏бра], све ће бити у реду.
examples.en: Be brave, everything will be fine.
The knight drew his sword.
They fought with swords until dawn.
My grandfather was a passionate hunter.
The hunters searched for the wolf all day.
This ring is very valuable.
She is a diligent student.

tips: «Вредан» means both «hardworking, diligent» and «valuable». The noun «вредност» is «value».
«Вредна ученица» - a diligent pupil. The sense «valuable» depends on context.

examples.en: Fill the glass with water, please.
I have to charge my phone.
The sheriff arrested the thief.
Call the sheriff, quick!
She has been painting landscapes for years.
Let's take a picture of ourselves by the fountain.

tips: «Сликати» also means to photograph: «сликати се» - to have one's picture taken, «слика» is both a painting and a photo. «Желим да се сликам за пасош».
Other ways to say it: правити фотографије, фотографисати. «Волим да сликам» - I like taking pictures.

examples.en: Our whole plan fell through.
The company went under after two years.
Which way is the train station?
You're going the wrong way.
Someone is stealing our newspapers from in front of the door.
It's not nice to steal from friends.

examples.sr: Та странка је дошла на [вла̑ст] пре две године.
examples.en: That party came to power two years ago.
The authorities closed the border.
He grew up on a farm in Vojvodina.
His parents have a cattle farm.

meanings: to treat (someone to food or drink)

examples.en: What do you offer us for dessert?

examples.sr: [Ну̀дили] су ми добар посао у Београду.
examples.en: I was offered a good job in Belgrade.
There must be some other solution.
I received a decision on my pension.
On what grounds do you claim that?
There are no grounds for such suspicion.

note: «на основу» + gen.: on the basis of

examples.en: I'm waiting for you at the entrance to the building.
Where is the entrance to the museum?

tips: In an address the entrance of an apartment building is «2. улаз», but in a long building each entrance usually has its own house number.

examples.sr: Морам да одем у [по̏шту] да платим рачуне.
examples.en: I have to go to the post office to pay the bills.
Has the mail come today?

note: «ићи у пошту» - to go to the post office
tips: The preposition is «у»: «у пошти» - at the post office. But «на интернету» - on the internet.

examples.en: I'm not interested in politics at all.
We don't talk about politics at the table.

meanings: to turn to, to apply to (reflexive)

examples.en: Please go to window number three.
Nobody paid any attention to him.

note: «обратити пажњу на» + acc.: to pay attention to

examples.en: My keys are in my pocket.
I pay for everything out of my own pocket.
He is the best player on the team.
There are eleven players on the field.
The elevator got stuck between floors.
We were stuck in traffic for an hour.

note: colloq. «заглавити у затвору» - to land in prison

examples.en: Let's take a short break.
We drink coffee during the break.
The police are still investigating the case.
Scientists are researching a new drug.
Run, the cops are coming!

examples.sr: Његов брат је [па̀ндӯр] у Новом Саду.
examples.en: His brother is a cop in Novi Sad.

tips: Historically a mercenary on the Austro-Hungarian border with the Ottoman Empire; in slang, a policeman.

examples.en: I urgently need to talk to you.
The patient was rushed to the hospital.
The police arrested the whole gang.
He was a member of a street gang.
My brother is a medical student.
There are a lot of students in Novi Sad.
I didn't sleep at all last night.
Where will you sleep tonight?

note: «ноћас» - both the night just past and the coming night
tips: It can mean the night just past or the coming one. To avoid confusion, say «синоћ» (last evening) and «вечерас» (this evening).

examples.en: Take out the trash, please.
He's a total scumbag!

note: said of a person, a rude insult
tips: «Ђубре» is garbage and, as an insult, a scoundrel; «ђубриво» is fertilizer. Same root, different meanings.

examples.en: I'm inviting you to lunch on Sunday.
Why do you keep calling me at night?

examples.sr: [Сигу́рно̄ст] деце нам је на првом месту.
examples.en: Our children's safety comes first.
He spoke with great confidence.
He works in the sales department.
Mom is in the surgical ward.
He jumped into the water from the bridge.
Prices have shot up again.
He never picks up the phone.
Get up, you'll be late!

note: «дизати телефон» - to pick up the phone

examples.en: I don't want to take a risk.

examples.sr: [Ризѝковао] је живот да би је спасао.
examples.en: He risked his life to save her.
He lives a few miles from here.
We were driving sixty miles an hour.

forms: заљубим се, заљубе се; impf. заљубљивати се

examples.sr: Мислим да сам се [заљу̀био] у тебе.
examples.en: I think I've fallen in love with you.

examples.sr: Први пут се [заљу́била] са петнаест година.
examples.en: She first fell in love at fifteen.

note: «заљубити се у» + acc.: to fall in love with someone

examples.sr: Наш син ће ове године у трећи [ра́зред].
examples.en: Our son will start third grade this year.
We were in the same class.
You look awful, are you sick?
I feel terrible about it.
My pay is two months late.
He has a good salary at the bank.
Thank God, we are all healthy.
I try to eat healthy food.

tips: Also «good for you»: здрава навика - a healthy habit, Поврће је здраво. A wish: «Да си ми здрав!». Idioms: «здрав као дрен» - healthy as a horse, «здрав и прав» - safe and sound.

examples.en: He wants revenge for his brother's death.
Revenge is not a solution.
Stop interrupting me all the time!
Sorry for interrupting the meeting.
My feet hurt from walking.
The baby has tiny feet.
Chop the onion into small pieces.
The hunter drew his bow.

tips: Garlic is «бели лук» (literally white onion), plain «лук» is the ordinary onion. Do not mix them up at the market.
The ordinary onion is «црни лук», garlic is «бели лук». Other kinds: «црвени лук» - red onion, «млади лук» - spring onion.

examples.en: Stir the soup so it doesn't burn.
Don't meddle in other people's business.

tips: «Мешати се» - to meddle: «Немој се мешати!». Related: «То вас се не тиче» - it's none of your business, «Остави ме на миру» - leave me alone.

examples.sr: Ћерка се по цео дан игра [лу̏ткама].
examples.en: My daughter plays with dolls all day.
Hi, babe, how are you?
We live in the southern part of the city.

examples.sr: [Ју̏жна] Србија је позната по доброј храни.
examples.en: Southern Serbia is known for good food.
We keep the wine in the cellar.
Go down to the cellar for some potatoes.
The doctor sees patients from eight o'clock.
Do you accept cards?
Turn right at the traffic light.

examples.sr: Покушао је да [скрѐне] разговор на другу тему.
examples.en: He tried to steer the conversation to another topic.

note: «скренути пажњу на» + acc.: to draw attention to

examples.en: This is my buddy Marko.
They were business partners.

forms: допаднем се, допадну се; допао се; impf. допадати се

examples.en: I really liked that movie.
I think she liked you.

note: the one who likes is in the dat.: «допао ми се» - I liked him

examples.en: He is a very capable worker.

examples.sr: У овом стању ниси [спо̀собна] да возиш.
examples.en: In this state you are not fit to drive.
Throw that in the trash.
The trash can is full again.
He threatened me with a knife.
The city is threatened by a flood.
Please wait a moment.
This is the right moment for it.
He brought a bottle of good wine.
Buy two bottles of water.
He died of lung cancer.
There are crayfish in this river.

meanings: to be good, to be of use

examples.en: This knife is no good at all.
What's wrong with you?
He used to get threats over the phone.
He is no threat to anyone.
Make a shopping list.
Your name isn't on the list.
He kept his promise.
Please fill out this form.
Sit in the back, Mom is in front.
The kids are in the back of the car.
The rain keeps falling.
We'll continue after the break.
You've ruined my whole evening!
The rain ruined our outing.

examples.sr: Изгубили смо [би̏тку], али не и рат.
examples.en: We lost the battle, but not the war.
This is a fight for life.
The concert will be held on Saturday.
He kept his word.
He didn't mention that he was married.
Nobody mentioned your name.
I'm watching a show about animals.
That show is on every Sunday evening.
He is the world tennis champion.

examples.sr: Деда је учествовао у Другом [све̏тском] рату.
examples.en: My grandfather took part in the Second World War.
We stayed with them only a short time.
He got a very short haircut.

examples.sr: Који ти је омиљени [пре́дмет] у школи?
examples.en: What's your favorite subject at school?
They found a strange object in the box.
You're making good progress in Serbian!
The disease is progressing very fast.
Let me know when you arrive.
Nobody informed us about it.
This is a public parking lot.
He is a well-known public figure.
Repeat after me.
I don't like to repeat the same things.
Every morning he takes the child to kindergarten.
Why do you bring strangers into the house?
Don't create problems out of nothing.
The artist creates in his studio.
This is a pedestrian zone.
We entered a restricted zone.
The kids are excited about the trip.
I was too excited to fall asleep.

tips: «Узбуђен због нечега»: «узбуђена сам због путовања». It covers both «worked up, nervous» and «excited» (looking forward to something).

examples.en: Play fair!
We ate until we were full.
We walked along a narrow path through the forest.
The bike path runs along the river.
A fire broke out in the building.
The firefighters quickly put out the fire.
What model of phone is this?
She works as a model in Milan.
My brother is a pilot for an airline.
The pilot landed the plane safely.
You need to see a doctor.
My father is a general practitioner.

note: «ићи код лекара» - to go to the doctor (код + gen.)

examples.en: The saleswoman was very kind.
Thank you, you are very kind.
Quick, the house is on fire!
The light is still on in the kitchen.
Come closer, I want to tell you something.
We work very closely together.
You can use my computer.
He used the wrong word.
We moved the things in a van.
A white van is parked in front of the house.
Smoking is prohibited inside the building.
We'll sort it out within the family.
I bought new pants.
These pants are tight on me.

tips: «Панталоне» are trousers; underwear is «гаће».

examples.en: The priest blessed our house.
His father was a priest.
Grandpa always wears a black hat.
Take your hat off in the house!
Send me the restaurant's location.
The apartment has an excellent location.
Everyone wore masks at the masquerade.
Take off the mask, I know who you are.
The landlord is asking for the rent.

examples.sr: Мој [га̏зда] ме је данас пустио раније.
examples.en: My boss let me leave early today.

tips: An owner of a business or property; colloquially, a person who is in control and acts with authority; figuratively, a rich man.

examples.en: I get up at six every day.
Get up, we've arrived!

related.en: to get up, to stand up

examples.en: Transfer the money to my account.

examples.sr: Можеш ли да ме [прѐбациш] до станице?
examples.en: Can you give me a lift to the station?

note: «пребацити некоме нешто» - to reproach someone for something
tips: «Пребацити» covers: to move («пребаци овај сто»), to transfer money («пребаци ми паре»), to reproach («немам шта да му пребацим»); «пребацити се» - to transfer to another faculty.

examples.en: I have to clean the kitchen before dinner.
Clean your shoes before you come in.
Health is the most important thing.
Smoking is bad for your health.

note: «на здравље!» - bless you (after a sneeze); also cheers, or enjoy (with food and drink)
tips: «Наздравље!» - bless you after a sneeze (to children - «Пис, мацо!»). On sick leave - «на боловању»; «Брзо оздравите!» - get well soon.

examples.sr: Дете већ зна да [рачу́на] до сто.
examples.en: The child can already count to a hundred.
You can always count on me.

tips: «Рачунати на» + acc. - to count on someone: «Рачунам на тебе» means «I'm counting on you». To count items, «бројати» is used.
«Рачунати на некога» - to count on someone; «то се не рачуна» - that doesn't count; «рачунати да» - to assume that.

examples.en: Why do you call me that?
This place is called Little Venice.
Before leaving, we all said goodbye.
His departure surprised us all.
The nurse took a blood sample.
Send us a sample of the fabric.
The doctor examined me carefully.
Check the text once more before sending.
He rejected all the accusations.
That is a very serious accusation.
The movie was a lot of fun.
He's a fun guy.
Life in the countryside has many advantages.
Pedestrians at a crossing have the right of way.
Move aside, I can't see anything!
Take your hands off me!
Turn off the light when you go out.
The firefighters quickly put out the fire.
You look wonderful tonight!
It was wonderful at the seaside.
He fell down the stairs.
Careful, the first step is slippery.

tips: Mostly used in the plural «степенице» - stairs: «Где су степенице?», «идемо степеницама».

examples.en: The car stopped in the middle of the road.
He called me in the middle of the night.
The prisoner begged for mercy.
They show no mercy to anyone.
Mom was very worried.
Why are you so upset?
I don't believe in vampires.

examples.sr: Реч [ва̀мпӣр] је дошла из српског језика.
examples.en: The word "vampire" came from the Serbian language.

tips: The word is of Serbian origin; the best-known vampire of Serbian folklore is Sava Savanović from Glišić's story.

examples.en: She was a victim of sexual harassment.
The doctor spoke about sexual health.
Don't move, I'm going to take your picture.
The dog is lying there and not moving.
It's so boring here.
I was bored at the lecture.
The commander ordered a retreat.

examples.sr: Ко ти је [нарѐдио] да то урадиш?
examples.en: Who ordered you to do that?
The explosion was heard all over the city.
Nobody was hurt in the explosion.
What time do you finish work?
He is finishing university this year.
In summer we go to the pool every day.
The hotel has a big pool.

note: «ићи на базен» - to go to the pool
tips: «На базену» - at the pool as a place (била је гужва на базену); «у базену» - in the water (деца се брчкају у базену).

examples.en: What an ugly building!
I had a bad dream last night.
The house is on top of the hill.
I have loads of work.
We moved recently.
I saw him in town recently.
Wait for me in the hallway.
The bathroom is at the end of the hallway.
The police found a body in the river.
Only over my dead body!
This stinks horribly.
He behaved disgustingly toward her.
I'm ten dinars short.
I miss you a lot.

tips: The missing thing is in the nominative: «Фали ми само 20 динара». Colloquially, to miss: «Фали ми породица»; «нешто ти фали» - something is wrong with you.
«Шта ти фали?» - what are you missing (often «what more do you want?»), «не фали ти ништа» - you have everything.
«Фали ми ...» - I lack ..., «фалиш ми» - I miss you. This is the colloquial variant of the standard «недостајати».

examples.en: Don't stand in the passage!
A secret passage leads to the cellar.
Her parents live in the north of the country.
A cold wind is blowing from the north.
The apartment has lost value.
To me, family is the greatest value.
Put the table in the middle of the room.
He found it hard to get used to the new environment.

note: «среда» is Wednesday; «средина» is the middle or the environment

examples.en: I am against any violence.
There is too much violence in the movie.
You have to bear the consequences of your decisions.
This will have serious consequences.
I put the keys over there, on the table.
Who is sitting over there in the corner?

note: bookish; in speech «тамо» is more common

examples.en: I don't drink alcohol.
He was driving under the influence of alcohol.
I can't sleep because of the noise.
Don't make noise, the baby is sleeping.
Would you like ice in your drink?
Watch out, there's ice on the road.
The committee rejected our proposal.
He is a member of the board of directors.

examples.sr: Можеш ли да ми [по̀зајмиш] хиљаду динара?
examples.en: Can you lend me a thousand dinars?
I borrowed a book from a friend.

tips: Two opposite meanings: to borrow (позајмио сам новац од брата) and to lend (позајмио сам брату новац). The context makes it clear.

examples.en: Wait a little, I'll be right back.
Can you wait a minute?
The police have footage from the camera.
The doctor looked at the lung scan.

related.en: to film, to record; to photograph

examples.en: I grew up in a small village.
When you grow up, you'll understand.
They met all our demands.
I submitted a visa application.
Do you get what I mean?
Honestly, I don't get any of it.
We're looking for a replacement for our sick colleague.
There is no substitute for experience.
Sorry, I'm in a hurry to get to work.
Don't hurry, we have plenty of time.
He needs time to regain his strength.

examples.sr: Мало је фалило да [по̀вратим] у аутобусу.
